text: A股零售股反复活跃，上海九百冲击涨停，大东方此前封板，国芳集团、大连友谊涨超5%，百大集团、天虹股份涨幅居前
text_en: A-share retail stocks remain active repeatedly, Shanghai Jiubai surges toward limit-up, Dadongfang previously hit limit-up, Guofang Group and Dalian Friendship up over 5%, Baida Group and Rainbow Digital Commercial among top gainers
